title: Prefix-aware cohort SLI instrumentation and automated circuit-healing visualizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We currently aggregate token-latency SLIs at too coarse a grain. That masks prefix-length, model-variant, and KV-hit correlations that drive regional circuit triggers and customer-visible tail latency. Goal: install a prefix-length-aware tagging pipeline and a cohorting surface that slices SLIs by (tenant cohort, model_variant, kv_hit, prefix_length_bucket, region) and surface an automated visualizer that suggests circuit 'healing' mitigations (scale, route, fallback variant) when thresholds breach. This ticket covers telemetry schema changes, small ingestion pipeline gating (sampled joins), dashboard panels, and a proto automated-suggester for oncall guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry: token-latency events include tags: model_variant, kv_hit:true|false, prefix_length_bucket:{1-8,9-64,65-256,256+}, tenant_cohort and region
Sampling: added a sampled synthetic header to preserve 100% prefix-length histograms for 0.5% of requests for edge analysis
Dashboards: New "cohorted prefix SLI" dashboard with heatmap, time-series for p50/p95/p99 per-cohort and a KV-hit vs decode-time scatter panel

Automated visualizer: MVP rule engine that surfaces top-3 suggested mitigations per breach (canary shift, model-variant fallback, short-prefix early-exit) in the dashboard and emits a GitHub issue template
Rollout: Schema backward-compatible; old consumers unaffected; new fields are optional and gated by feature flag (obs.prefix_cohorting)
Tests: unit tests for ingestion tagging, integration test generating synthetic tenant profiles to verify cohort buckets and dashboard panels

notes: Implementation plan: finish ingestion schema -> add sampler hook in edge proxy -> enrich in metric-joiner -> persist prefix histograms to hot-timeseries with TTL 14d -> dashboard queries shard by region and cohort
Cardinality guardrails: max distinct tenant_cohort x model_variant combinations allowed = 500; if exceeded, automatically roll up to 'model_group' to avoid explosion

Automated suggestions rules (MVP): if p99 increases >25% and kv_hit rate <30% => suggest 'prefetch-KV' policy and open issue; if regional p95 latency > SLO and admission_rate>target => suggest temporary capacity shift to adjacent region
